description: Post messages to Slack and list channels — the notification half of a team-health or ops workflow.
credentials_note: Read via __rc_helpers__['vault_get']('slack') at call time, expected shape {"bot_token": "..."} (falls back to "api_key") — set up in Studio -> Integrations -> slack. Bot tokens don't expire by default. Never read from os.environ.

commands.name: list_channels
commands.description: List channels the bot can see, to find a channel_id by name.

limit.help: Max channels to return (Slack paginates above 100; not followed automatically).

commands.name: post_message
commands.description: Post a message to a channel.

channel.help: Channel ID (from list_channels) or name, e.g. #fika-sync.

text.help: Message body. Always sent as the fallback text even if you don't use blocks.
